_comment: The Guide -- first NPC, lore-canonical Beatrice's voice fed through a hollow male body. Per dialogue.md 'Old register, calls Vagrant Pilgrim' + story.md (R2 reveal hinges on his death). Stub iteration: humanoid skeleton (reuse player rig), Allied faction (player can't damage him with the current factionsHostile rule), is_npc=true (gates future dialogue + interaction prompt), no actions (he stands until scripted-spawn for the Lupa-defeat beat ships). Behavior tree falls through to LeafIdle because perception is gated by faction=Hostile (see tickPerception in gameplay/Perception.cpp) -- the Guide never aggros the player. Vision/awareness fields irrelevant because of the gate; left at humanoid defaults for consistency with shade.
_comment_face_player: Yaw-acknowledgment: turns to face the player when within 6m, in passive (non-combat, non-scripted-walk) state. Souls-style 'the NPC notices you walking by.' Tunable per archetype; 0 = disabled. Per docs/design/insight_revelation_system.md authoring guide.
